nights.name: Whitechapel
nights.extract: Whitechapel is an American deathcore band from Knoxville, Tennessee. The band is named after the Whitechapel district in east London, England, where Jack the Ripper committed a series of murders. The group comprises vocalist Phil Bozeman, guitarists Ben Savage, Alex Wade, and Zach Householder, bassist Gabe Crisp and drummer Brandon Zackey. Their core lineup, with the exception of the drummer, has remained consistent since Householder replaced original guitarist Brandon Cagle in 2007. Founded in 2006 by Bozeman and Savage, the band has released nine studio albums and twenty-two music videos, and is currently signed to Metal Blade Records. tr.who: Whitechapel, Knoxville, Tennessee'den bir Amerikalı deathcore grubudur. facts: Grubun adı, İngiltere'nin doğu Londra bölgesindeki Whitechapel semtinden alınmıştır; Jack the Ripper bu semtte bir dizi cinayet işlemiştir.

nights.title: Les Louanges

nights.extract: Les Louanges is a Canadian indie pop act from Québec, created and performed by Vincent Roberge. He currently has 3 released albums with his label Bonsound.
